description: Erection of a single storey extension to the existing garage and change of use into a gym with associated elevational changes.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall be as shown on the approved plans

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (P-1, P-2, P-3, P-4, P-5, P-6, P-7, P-8 and P-9 [received 24/10/2019]; and Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment and Planning Statement [received 11/10/2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used incidental to the use of 89 Princes Avenue, W3 8LY and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
